Roadmap

larder: a self-hosted, FLOSS household food system (recipes, weekly dinner planning, shared shopping list; later, pantry estimates driven by receipts). Specs: docs/goals.md, docs/requirements.md, docs/specs/, docs/decisions/. Slices titled "Interview:" collect the owner's decisions and come before the slices that depend on them. Every slice has an "Owner input" section listing what to confirm before starting. Household-specific answers go in the gitignored local/ folder, never in committed files.

Goals

- G1: Answer "what's for dinner?" in seconds, from meals the household actually makes.
- G2: One shared shopping list that every household member trusts.
- G3: Reduce waste and duplicate purchases using order data instead of manual logging (Phase 2).
- G4: Near-zero required upkeep; optional taps improve accuracy, none are required.
- G5: Usable by non-technical household members without help.
- G6: Portable: any household can run it with its own stores, sources and network (ADR 0015, 0016).

Non-goals

- NG1: Placing store orders automatically.
- NG2: Nutrition or calorie tracking.
- NG3: Access from the public internet.
- NG4: Multi-household or hosted operation in the MVP (future direction, ADR 0016).
- NG5: Exact, item-by-item inventory tracking.
